rules.rule_name: Warfarin and NSAIDs Absolute Bleeding Hazard

conditions: concomitant oral anticoagulant and systemic NSAID

clinical_action.explanation: Concurrent use causes synergistic inhibition of hemostasis and gastric mucosal injury, dramatically increasing gastrointestinal bleeding risk.
clinical_action.immediate_action: Discontinue systemic NSAID. Substitute with acetaminophen for mild-moderate analgesia, or topical agent if indicated.

rules.source_authority: FDA Black Box Warning / CHEST Antithrombotic Guidelines
rules.known_limitations: Short-term selective COX-2 inhibitors still carry elevated risk and require gastroprotection.

rules.rule_name: Apixaban and Diclofenac Severe Gastrointestinal Bleeding Hazard

conditions: concomitant direct oral factor Xa inhibitor and systemic NSAID

clinical_action.explanation: Concurrent use of DOACs with systemic NSAIDs significantly increases major bleeding risk by combining factor Xa inhibition with platelet dysfunction and gastric mucosal erosions.
clinical_action.immediate_action: Avoid concurrent therapy. Switch analgesia to paracetamol or topical non-systemic formulation.

rules.source_authority: ESC Guidelines on Atrial Fibrillation / FDA Eliquis Labeling
rules.known_limitations: Applies across all DOACs (rivaroxaban, edoxaban, dabigatran).

rules.rule_name: Methotrexate and Trimethoprim-Sulfamethoxazole Bone Marrow Aplasia

conditions: concomitant antifolate antimetabolite and dihydrofolate reductase inhibitor

clinical_action.explanation: Combined antifolate effect and reduced renal tubular clearance of methotrexate leads to fatal pancytopenia and severe mucositis.
clinical_action.immediate_action: Avoid combination completely. Choose non-antifolate antimicrobial.

rules.known_limitations: Even low-dose weekly methotrexate is susceptible to this life-threatening interaction.

conditions: potent CYP3A4 inhibitor with CYP3A4-metabolized statin

clinical_action.explanation: Strong CYP3A4 inhibition increases simvastatin plasma concentrations by up to 10-fold, causing acute rhabdomyolysis and renal failure.
clinical_action.immediate_action: Suspend simvastatin during macrolide therapy or use non-CYP3A4 statin (e.g. rosuvastatin, pravastatin) or azithromycin.

rules.source_authority: FDA Drug Safety Labeling / AHA Scientific Statement
rules.known_limitations: Same interaction applies to erythromycin and high-dose lovastatin.

rules.rule_name: Sildenafil and Nitroglycerin Severe Refractory Hypotension

conditions: concomitant PDE-5 inhibitor and organic nitrate vasodilator

clinical_action.explanation: Synergistic enhancement of cyclic GMP pathway causes profound, life-threatening hypotension and coronary hypoperfusion.
clinical_action.immediate_action: Contraindicated. Maintain at least 24-48 hours separation between PDE-5 inhibitors and nitrates.

rules.source_authority: AHA/ACC Guidelines on Angina and Ischemic Heart Disease
rules.known_limitations: Applies to all PDE-5 inhibitors (tadalafil requires 48 hours separation).

conditions: dual aldosterone blockade / potassium retention in renal impairment

clinical_action.explanation: Concurrent use of potassium-sparing diuretics with ACE inhibitors or ARBs, especially in chronic kidney disease, can cause fatal cardiac arrhythmias from hyperkalemia.
clinical_action.immediate_action: Check baseline serum potassium and eGFR. Discontinue potassium supplements and monitor potassium within 1 week of initiation.

rules.source_authority: KDIGO Clinical Practice Guideline for Diabetes and CKD
rules.known_limitations: Can be co-prescribed in heart failure under strict specialist supervision and frequent lab monitoring.

rules.rule_name: Isotretinoin / Valproate / ACEi Pregnancy Teratogenic Never Event

conditions: Category X teratogen exposure during active pregnancy

clinical_action.explanation: High risk of severe major congenital malformations, craniofacial dysmorphism, cardiovascular defects, and fetal death.
clinical_action.immediate_action: Immediately discontinue medication. Obtain pregnancy test and refer to maternal-fetal medicine specialist.

rules.source_authority: FDA iPLEDGE Program / ACOG Practice Guidelines / Briggs Drugs in Pregnancy
rules.known_limitations: Strict negative pregnancy tests and two effective forms of contraception required before initiation.
